text_block_list.name: Voice of Destiny
text_block_list.text:
(Win! WIN!!!! ――You have to win, no matter 
what!!!!)

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: Ooo-OOOOOOOH O o o OOOOooO!!!!

I couldn't believe the sight before my 
eyes. Epiphaneia had completely lost her 
composure, and was simply—wildly exploding 
with emotion.

—Before I knew it, all I was doing was 
praying. Not for victory, but first and 
foremost, for her safety...

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: Haa...! Haa...!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: Alright! Yes, yes! YESSSSSS!!!!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: I am!! The Derby Umamusume!!
(Oooooohhhh...!)
choice_data_list:
(Thank goodness... I managed to finish the 
race safely...)

text_block_list.text:
—The sheer baseline strength was on 
another level. Epiphaneia possessed such 
monstrous power that she could run wild to 
that extent and still emerge victorious.
choice_data_list_en: (Thank goodness... She finished the run safely...)

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: Come on, everyone!! Scream even louder!!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
"Congratulate us!!!! —On the destiny you 
share with me!!!!"

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Waaaaah...! That was seriously amazing, 
Epi...! Seriously, you're just way too 
strong...!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
...It's almost kind of scary. There have 
been all kinds of Derby Umamusume, but... 
she feels a bit different somehow.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
It feels... different. She's not... 
Epi-san.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: Because... I could never be like that...

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: —Huh?

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
No, I need to... hold back 
more—flawlessly...

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: Trainer... I was completely useless.

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Before the race, the voice of destiny... 
cried out, 'Win!' to me—

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah, thank you. Phew...

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
"But why?! The voice of destiny has always 
just pushed me forward, so why now...?"
choice_data_list:
It was like... it was swallowing you 
whole...
It was like it was swallowing you whole...

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
"That's right...! She ran in front of 
me—and pulled me along!"
choice_data_list: 君を、呑みこんでるみたいだった……
貴方を、呑みこんでるみたいだった……
choice_data_list_en: It was like it was swallowing you whole...
It looked like it was swallowing you whole...

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Why? Why does the 'Voice of Fate' provoke 
me like this!?

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Is that really... the right way after all? 
But that goes against what you believe in.

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
In fact, nobody felt that sense of destiny 
today! ...Even though it was the Derby!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: ...Even though it was... the Derby.

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
...Still, I want to believe. In both the 
voice of destiny and in you. I want to 
believe in both!

With her so confused right now, saying too 
much would be counterproductive. Getting 
her to calm down comes first.

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: Time?
choice_data_list_en: ...Could you give me a little time?
...Could you give me a little time?

text_block_list.text:
After this comes the summer training camp, 
where the Umamusume work to hone their 
skills. During that time, I can help 
untangle the confusion she's currently 
trapped in—
choice_data_list: 『菊花賞』では、必ず最高の結果に導く
choice_data_list_en: I will definitely lead you to the best possible result in the 'Kikuka Sho.'

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
choice_data_list: ――貴方の望む未来へ、導くから
choice_data_list_en: ――I will guide you to the future you desire.
âI will guide you to the future you desire.

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: Understood. I will await your decision!!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
"It's okay, I believe in you! Because 
you're my destiny."

Once Epiphaneia calms down and returns to 
the waiting room—

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: Congratulations, Epi.

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: Kris S! You came to watch?!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: But, I...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: "...You won. That result is undeniable."

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
Congratulations on becoming a Derby 
Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: Thank you!

Whenever I'm alone, regret grips my chest 
tight. How I ran today—it's entirely my 
own fault.

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: "Understood! I shall follow your lead!"

"—I was too naive, there's no denying it. 
There must have been so much more I could 
have done."

"I tried everything, yet I failed... If I 
am to move forward from here, I must be 
flawlessly, death-defyingly prepared."

Late at night, I gaze at the document I've 
just written. It was a letter of 
resignation. If I couldn't lead her to 
victory in the Kikuka Sho—

I fold it up small so I can carry it with 
me anywhere. It's not something to run 
away with, but a proof of my resolve to 
guide her to where she wants to be.
choice_data_list: （トレーナーそのものを、やめる）

text_block_list.text:
So that I don't lose Epiphaneia, and to 
give her the future that her incredible 
talent deserves—this time, I will answer 
her trust.
